meta.name: Stingray Classica
meta.description:
Discover breathtaking classical music concerts, operas, and ballets from some of the grandest venues around the world.

Shows: Mozart Clarinet Concerto in A Major, Anabel de la Mora, Andrés Carrillo, Daniel Cerón & Coro de la Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, Galaxymphony Strikes Back, Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 5, 'Emperor', La Bayadere
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, Plex
